From e152575f5ea5ea798ca989c852afb763189dee60 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: markrmiller <markrmiller@apache.org>
Date: Tue, 25 Oct 2016 12:39:37 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] SOLR-9536: OldBackupDirectory timestamp field needs to be
 initialized to avoid NPE.


diff --git a/solr/CHANGES.txt b/solr/CHANGES.txt
index 2f4827b2294..b693543c1c0 100644
--- a/solr/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/solr/CHANGES.txt
@@ -214,6 +214,9 @@ Bug Fixes
 * SOLR-9441: Solr collection backup on HDFS can only be manipulated by the Solr process owner. 
  (Hrishikesh Gadre via Mark Miller)
 
+* SOLR-9536: OldBackupDirectory timestamp field needs to be initialized to avoid NPE.
+ (Hrishikesh Gadre via Mark Miller)
+ 
 Optimizations
 ----------------------
 

diff --git a/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/handler/OldBackupDirectory.java b/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/handler/OldBackupDirectory.java
index 2b19116c926..79c5f09f7e9 100644
--- a/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/handler/OldBackupDirectory.java
+++ b/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/handler/OldBackupDirectory.java
@@ -32,7 +32,7 @@ class OldBackupDirectory implements Comparable<OldBackupDirectory> {
 
   private URI basePath;
   private String dirName;
-  private Optional<Date> timestamp;
+  private Optional<Date> timestamp = Optional.empty();
 
   public OldBackupDirectory(URI basePath, String dirName) {
     this.dirName = Preconditions.checkNotNull(dirName);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **`solr/CHANGES.txt`**:
   - A new entry was added to document the bug fix related to SOLR-9536. The entry states that the "OldBackupDirectory timestamp field needs to be initialized to avoid NPE (Null Pointer Exception)" and credits Hrishikesh Gadre and Mark Miller.

2. **`solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/handler/OldBackupDirectory.java`**:
   - The declaration of the `timestamp` field was modified. 
   - Changed from `private Optional<Date> timestamp;` to `private Optional<Date> timestamp = Optional.empty();` to ensure that the `timestamp` field is initialized and thus avoid a potential Null Pointer Exception.

### Relationships
The modification in `OldBackupDirectory.java` addresses the issue described in the `CHANGES.txt` file. Specifically, the addition of the initialization for the `timestamp` field directly resolves the bug identified in SOLR-9536, which is aimed at preventing a Null Pointer Exception (NPE) in the code when the `timestamp` field is accessed without being initialized. The change in the Java file is the implementation of the fix that is mentioned in the changelog.
